config.name: dictionary_families_gemma3
config.description: Gemma 3 1B, one site (residual after L13; a subset at L17), many dictionary families from Gemma Scope 2: residual SAEs (4 widths x 3 L0s + a second seed), transcoders (all layers / single layer, affine skip), MLP-out SAEs, CLTs, attention SAEs and weakly causal crosscoders, all as decompositions of the same residual (harness/composite.py: x_hat = x - sum of sublayer errors). One fixed DAS subspace per cell scores every dictionary: how much task state does each family keep, and is the rest in its error?
notes: breadth pilot (docs/PILOT_BREADTH_PLAN.md): exploratory, post hoc; generated by scripts/make_pilot_configs.py
